sources.title: SSI SCHÄFER High Bay Warehouse
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工廠輸送線節拍平衡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平行與串聯時間沒有混加，理想上界與實際排程分開標示。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Parallel and serial times are not confused, and ideal bounds remain distinct from actual schedules.
related.difference: 區分客戶需求節拍與各站週期，找出平均時間會掩蓋的瓶頸。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish demand takt from station cycle time and expose bottlenecks hidden by averages.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆速且兩軸同動時單程時間max(x/vx,y/vy)；往返加取放時間，忽略加減速是樂觀下界。 教學水平距離30 m、速度2 m/s，垂直12 m、速度1 m/s，取放合計10 s。 單程max(15,12)=15 s；週期2×15+10=40 s，理想吞吐3600/40=90次/h。
需求節拍=可用時間/需求量；無緩衝停機的理想串線吞吐由最慢站決定。 教學班次有效25200 s，需求420件，三站週期35、55、65 s。 需求節拍60 s；瓶頸65 s，理想班產25200/65=387.692件，完整件最多387件。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At constant simultaneous speeds, one-way time=max(x/vx, y/vy); round-trip plus handling gives an optimistic bound omitting acceleration. Teaching horizontal 30 m at 2 m/s, vertical 12 m at 1 m/s, total handling 10 s. One-way=max(15,12)=15 s; cycle 40 s and ideal throughput 90 cycles/h.

Takt=available time/demand; an ideal serial line without downtime is limited by its slowest station. Teaching productive shift 25200 s, demand 420 units, station cycles 35,55,65 s. Takt 60 s; bottleneck 65 s gives 387.692 theoretical units/shift, at most 387 completed whole units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工廠數位分身驗證
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：平行與串聯時間沒有混加，理想上界與實際排程分開標示。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Parallel and serial times are not confused, and ideal bounds remain distinct from actual schedules.
related.difference: 區分程式是否解對方程與模型是否代表實體，避免只看平均誤差為零。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish solving equations correctly from representing reality, and avoid relying on zero mean error alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆速且兩軸同動時單程時間max(x/vx,y/vy)；往返加取放時間，忽略加減速是樂觀下界。 教學水平距離30 m、速度2 m/s，垂直12 m、速度1 m/s，取放合計10 s。 單程max(15,12)=15 s；週期2×15+10=40 s，理想吞吐3600/40=90次/h。
殘差ri=預測−量測；bias=平均r，RMSE=√[平均(r²)]；零bias可由正負誤差抵消。 合成保留資料四個週期時間殘差[1,−1,2,−2] s，不使用它們調參。 bias=0 s，RMSE=√(10/4)=1.58114 s；平均零不代表逐筆正確。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At constant simultaneous speeds, one-way time=max(x/vx, y/vy); round-trip plus handling gives an optimistic bound omitting acceleration. Teaching horizontal 30 m at 2 m/s, vertical 12 m at 1 m/s, total handling 10 s. One-way=max(15,12)=15 s; cycle 40 s and ideal throughput 90 cycles/h.

Residualri=prediction−measurement; bias=meanr andRMSE=sqrt(mean(r_i²)); opposite errors can cancel bias. Four synthetic held-out cycle-time residuals[1,−1,2,−2] s, not used for tuning. Bias 0 s, RMSE 1.58114 s; zero mean does not imply accurate individual predictions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
